title: Qwen Office Launches GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek V4Pro, Three Domestic Flagship Models Complete Aggregation

content_html:
Alibaba's Agent product "Qwen Office" announced the launch of two cutting-edge models, GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek V4Pro, on the evening of August 14th. Starting from today, users can directly select these models on the "Cutting-Edge Models" section of the product's homepage. Adding the previously integrated Qwen3.8-Max, Qwen Office has become the first office Agent product in the industry that simultaneously covers the three domestic flagship models from Alibaba, Zhipu, and DeepSeek.

DeepSeek V4Pro and GLM-5.3 were released on the evening of August 13th and August 14th, respectively, both being the latest flagship models from their respective companies. DeepSeek V4Pro features a context length of up to 1 million tokens and a maximum output of 384K, with a focus on enhancing long-term task and Agent task integration capabilities; GLM-5.3 achieves approximately a 50% performance improvement based on its base model through post-training, showing strong performance in scenarios such as programming, long-term complex engineering tasks, and network security defense.

"Qwen Office" started its public beta test on August 3rd, integrating three products: QoderWork, MuleRun, and Wukong. It is the first office Agent product in the industry that supports desktop Agent, cloud Agent, and enterprise collaboration Agent simultaneously. Currently, both individual and enterprise users can experience it through the official website. The product plans to launch an independent app and an international version in the future.

This integration marks Qwen Office's formal shift toward a multi-model aggregation strategy, further enriching the availability options of domestic models in enterprise-level Agent scenarios, following similar products such as Tencent WorkBuddy and Byte TRAE Work.

content_html_zh:
8月14日晚，阿里巴巴代理产品“Qwen Office”宣布推出两款前沿机型GLM-5.3和DeepSeek V4Pro。 即日起，用户可以在产品主页的“前沿机型”部分直接选择这些机型。 加上此前集成的Qwen3.8-Max，Qwen Office成为业内首款同时覆盖阿里巴巴、智浦、DeepSeek三大国内旗舰机型的办公Agent产品。

DeepSeek V4Pro和GLM-5.3分别于8月13日晚和8月14日晚发布，都是各自公司的最新旗舰机型。 DeepSeek V4Pro的上下文长度高达100万个token，最大输出384K，重点增强长期任务和Agent任务集成能力； GLM-5.3通过后训练，在基础模型的基础上实现了约50%的性能提升，在编程、长期复杂工程任务、网络安全防御等场景中表现出了强劲的性能。

《Qwen Office》于8月3日开始公测，集成了QoderWork、MuleRun、Wukong三款产品。 业界首款同时支持桌面Agent、云Agent、企业协作Agent的办公Agent产品。 目前，个人和企业用户都可以通过官网进行体验。 该产品未来计划推出独立App和国际版本。

此次整合标志着Qwen Office继腾讯WorkBuddy、Byte TRAE Work等同类产品之后，正式转向多机型聚合策略，进一步丰富国内机型在企业级Agent场景下的可用性选择。
